prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution image of a modern white cabinet door being gently opened by a human hand, positioned at the upper right edge of the frame. The focus is on the sleek, minimalist design of the cabinet, with clean lines and a smooth matte finish. Prominently featured are two shiny, metallic soft-close hinges, their polished chrome surfaces reflecting the soft, diffuse lighting. The background is a seamless continuation of the white cabinet interior, creating a sense of cleanliness and simplicity. The composition is tight and intimate, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the hand, door, and hinges in sharp focus while subtly blurring the background. The overall color palette is dominated by crisp whites and cool silvers, evoking a sense of modernity and precision. The lighting is even and natural, with no harsh shadows, enhancing the pristine and orderly atmosphere of the scene.
